title: Multi-document upload wizard
purpose: Upload multiple document types against selected environments with consistent review and validation.
behaviour: Upload multiple document types against selected environments with consistent review and validation.
Render explicit empty, populated and read-only states.
Expose app/server interaction through callbacks or adapters rather than global state.

demoScenarios.title: Default populated
demoScenarios.instruction: Render the supplied mock data and show the normal ready state.

demoScenarios.title: Primary interaction
demoScenarios.instruction: Exercise the main output: Tagged attachment payload. Show the state change immediately.

demoScenarios.title: Validation or empty
demoScenarios.instruction: Demonstrate missing/invalid input with useful inline guidance and no browser-native alert.

demoScenarios.title: Read-only or complete
demoScenarios.instruction: Demonstrate the completed/locked form of the same component without hiding its context.
